SELECT t.id,t.name,t.icon,t.icon_dark,COUNT(b.id) AS blogCount FROM tags t LEFT JOIN blog_tags bt ON t.id = bt.tagId LEFT JOIN blogs b ON b.id = bt.blogId AND b.is_delete = 0 AND b.published = 1 WHERE t.is_delete = 0 GROUP BY t.id,t.name,t.icon,t.icon_dark

SELECT t.id AS tagId, t.name AS tagName, b.id AS blogId, b.title, b.description, b.createTime, b.updateTime, u.id AS authorId, u.username AS authorName, c.id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, blog_tag.id AS blogTagId, blog_tag.name AS blogTagName FROM tags t LEFT JOIN blog_tags bt ON bt.tagId = t.id LEFT JOIN blogs b ON b.id = bt.blogId AND b.is_delete = 0 AND b.published = 1 LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = b.createUser LEFT JOIN category c ON b.categoryId = c.id AND c.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN blog_tags blog_bt ON blog_bt.blogId = b.id LEFT JOIN tags blog_tag ON blog_tag.id = blog_bt.tagId AND blog_tag.is_delete = 0 WHERE t.id = #{tagId} AND t.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY b.createTime DESC, b.id DESC
